title: Data-Driven Stochastic Optimal Control for Intraday Electricity Trading by Renewable Producers
abstract: arXiv:2604.27700v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid growth of weather-dependent renewable generation increases price volatility and imbalance penalty risk in power markets, creating the need for advanced quantitative trading strategies. We develop a data-driven continuous-time stochastic optimal control framework for intraday electricity trading using stochastic differential equations with drift terms ensuring mean reversion to deterministic forecast trajectories. Production follows a Jacobi diffusion, while prices follow an asymmetric jump-diffusion to reflect the heavy-tailed behavior observed in intraday markets. The framework accounts for realistic market features by incorporating gate closure and energy-based imbalance settlement over the delivery window, where the path-dependent imbalance cost is handled by state augmentation to preserve the Markovian structure. translated_title: 面向可再生能源发电商日内电力交易的数据驱动随机最优控制
translated_abstract: 天气依赖型可再生能源发电的快速增长加剧了电力市场的价格波动性和不平衡惩罚风险，因此需要先进的量化交易策略。我们开发了一个用于日内电力交易的数据驱动连续时间随机最优控制框架，采用带漂移项的随机微分方程，确保发电量和价格的均值回归至确定性预测轨迹。其中，发电量服从Jacobi扩散过程，价格则服从非对称跳扩散过程，以刻画日内市场中观察到的重尾特征。该框架纳入了现实市场特征，包括市场关闭时间以及交割窗口内基于电量的不平衡结算机制，其中路径依赖的不平衡成本通过状态增广方法处理，以保持系统的马尔可夫结构。价值函数通过动态规划原理由三阶段序列刻画……
tldr: 本文提出一个数据驱动的连续时间随机最优控制框架，用于可再生能源发电商的日内电力交易，通过Jacobi扩散和非对称跳扩散分别建模发电量与价格，并利用状态增广处理路径依赖的不平衡成本以最小化惩罚风险。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a data-driven continuous-time stochastic optimal control framework for renewable producers' intraday electricity trading, using Jacobi diffusion for production and asymmetric jump-diffusion for prices, with state augmentation to handle path-dependent imbalance costs.
